kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.dead: You cannot attempt a breakthrough right now.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.busy: You are already in the middle of a breakthrough.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.deviation: Your qi is still in chaos from a Qi Deviation (%s s left). Recover first.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.max: You stand at the very summit of the path. There is nothing left to break through.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.not_peak: You are not at a bottleneck yet. Reach %s first.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.not_full: Your cultivation is not full yet (%s / %s). Keep cultivating.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.riding: Get off your mount first: a breakthrough needs both feet on the ground.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.airborne: Land first: a breakthrough needs both feet on the ground.
kultivator.breakthrough.refuse.root: Your spiritual root has not been tested yet. Use %s first.
kultivator.breakthrough.awakening.start: The qi of heaven and earth rushes towards you... Stay still and let it in!
kultivator.breakthrough.gathering.start: You gather your qi against the bottleneck... Stay still! (Chance of success: %s)
kultivator.breakthrough.cancel.moved: You moved: the gathered qi scatters. The breakthrough was interrupted (no harm done).
kultivator.breakthrough.cancel.hurt: You were hurt: the gathered qi scatters. The breakthrough was interrupted (no harm done).
kultivator.breakthrough.cancel.none: No breakthrough is running for that player.
kultivator.breakthrough.cancel.left_area: You left the tribulation ground before the first strike. The heavens lose interest and the clouds disperse (no harm done).
kultivator.breakthrough.cancel.trial_tim: The trial never ended. The breakthrough was called off (no harm done).
kultivator.breakthrough.trial.passed: Your Dao heart holds firm! Now the heavens themselves will test you.
kultivator.breakthrough.trial.failed: Your heart wavered in the trial. The breakthrough fails.
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.subtitle: %s strikes are coming. Hold your ground!
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.chat.0: Dark clouds gather above you. The heavens have noticed your defiance: %s strikes of heavenly thunder will fall.
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.chat.1: The sky of the Nether boils with crimson clouds. Hellfire answers your defiance: %s strikes will fall.
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.chat.2: The void itself stirs above you. Endless darkness answers your defiance: %s strikes will fall.
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.stay: Stay within %s blocks of this spot. Leaving before the first strike calls it off; leaving later means failure.
kultivator.breakthrough.omen.countdown: The first strike falls in %s s
kultivator.breakthrough.fled: You fled the tribulation ground. The judgement of the heavens turns to ruin!
kultivator.breakthrough.fail.strike: The heavenly strike was too strong for you. Your foundation cracks!
kultivator.breakthrough.fail.chance: The bottleneck holds firm. Your qi rebounds on you!
kultivator.breakthrough.fail.hardcore: Hardcore mode: a failed breakthrough costs you a whole realm!
kultivator.breakthrough.fail.lost_bar: The failed breakthrough costs you 30%% of your cultivation progress (Stored Qi is untouched).
kultivator.breakthrough.died: You fell during the breakthrough. The backlash will catch up with you when you return.
kultivator.breakthrough.died.backlash: The backlash of your failed tribulation catches up with you.
kultivator.breakthrough.left.backlash: You left the world in the middle of your breakthrough. The heavens do not forget: the backlash catches up with you now.
kultivator.breakthrough.protectors.wave: The heavenly phenomenon draws monsters to you! (%s)
kultivator.breakthrough.success.subtitle: %s breakthrough
kultivator.breakthrough.success.awakenin: Your meridians open and qi flows through your body. You have stepped onto the path: %s!
kultivator.breakthrough.announce.tribula: %s survived the Heavenly Tribulation and reached %s! (%s)
kultivator.breakthrough.test.start: Test tribulation at the strength of %s.
kultivator.breakthrough.test.success: Test tribulation survived. This was only a test: your rank and quality do not change.
kultivator.breakthrough.test.failed: Test tribulation failed. Only the Qi Deviation is applied.
kultivator.breakthrough.deviation.start: Qi Deviation! Your qi runs wild for %s s: no qi regeneration, half cultivation speed, weakness and slowness.
kultivator.breakthrough.deviation.worse: Your Qi Deviation worsens (%s s left).
kultivator.breakthrough.deviation.recove: Your qi settles into its channels again. The Qi Deviation has passed.
death.attack.kultivator_tribulation: %1$s was struck down by the Heavenly Tribulation
death.attack.kultivator_tribulation.play: %1$s was struck down by the Heavenly Tribulation while fighting %2$s
death.attack.kultivator_qi_deviation: %1$s was consumed by a Qi Deviation
death.attack.kultivator_qi_deviation.pla: %1$s was consumed by a Qi Deviation while fighting %2$s

advancement.kultivator.awakening.descrip: Open your meridians and step from Mortal into Qi Refining.
advancement.kultivator.first_breakthroug: Break through a bottleneck and establish your foundation.
advancement.kultivator.qi_deviation.desc: Fail a breakthrough and feel your qi run wild.
advancement.kultivator.nether_tribulatio: Survive a Hellfire Tribulation in the Nether.
advancement.kultivator.end_tribulation.d: Survive a Void Tribulation in the End.
advancement.kultivator.true_immortal_tri: Survive the final tribulation and become a True Immortal.
